name: Push-Up
instructions: ["Start in a high plank with hands slightly wider than shoulder width.","Keep your body in a straight line and lower your chest toward the floor.","Press through your palms until your arms are extended again."]

name: Incline Push-Up
instructions: ["Place your hands on a stable elevated surface and step your feet back.","Keep your body straight as you lower your chest toward the surface.","Push away from the surface to return to the start."]

name: Bodyweight Squat
instructions: ["Stand with feet around shoulder width apart.","Sit your hips back and bend your knees while keeping your chest up.","Descend comfortably, then push through your feet to stand."]

name: Walking Lunge
instructions: ["Stand tall and step forward with one leg.","Lower until both knees are comfortably bent.","Push through the front foot and step directly into the next lunge."]

name: Step-Up
instructions: ["Place one foot fully on a stable step or bench.","Drive through that foot to raise your body onto the platform.","Step down under control and repeat, then switch sides."]

name: Glute Bridge
instructions: ["Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat.","Brace your core and press through your heels.","Lift your hips, squeeze your glutes, then lower under control."]

name: Standing Calf Raise
instructions: ["Stand tall with feet about hip width apart.","Rise onto the balls of your feet as high as comfortable.","Pause briefly, then lower your heels slowly."]

name: Pull-Up
instructions: ["Hang from a pull-up bar with a comfortable overhand grip.","Pull your chest upward by driving your elbows down.","Lower yourself under control until your arms are extended."]

name: Inverted Row
instructions: ["Hold a secure horizontal bar and position your body underneath it.","Keep your body straight and pull your chest toward the bar.","Lower under control until your arms are extended."]

name: Bench Dip
instructions: ["Place your hands on the edge of a stable bench behind you.","Lower your body by bending your elbows while keeping close to the bench.","Press through your hands to extend your elbows again."]

name: Plank
instructions: ["Support yourself on your forearms and toes.","Keep your head, hips, and heels in one straight line.","Brace your core and hold while breathing normally."]

name: Side Plank
instructions: ["Lie on one side and support your upper body on your forearm.","Lift your hips until your body forms a straight line.","Hold with your core braced, then repeat on the other side."]

name: Dead Bug
instructions: ["Lie on your back with hips and knees bent and arms pointing upward.","Brace your core and slowly extend one leg and the opposite arm.","Return to center and alternate sides without arching your lower back."]

name: Bird Dog
instructions: ["Begin on hands and knees with a neutral spine.","Extend one arm forward and the opposite leg backward.","Pause, return to the start, and alternate sides."]

name: Bicycle Crunch
instructions: ["Lie on your back with hands lightly beside your head.","Bring one knee toward your torso while rotating the opposite shoulder toward it.","Switch sides in a controlled pedaling motion."]

name: Crunch
instructions: ["Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat.","Brace your abdomen and lift your shoulder blades from the floor.","Pause briefly, then lower under control."]

name: Reverse Crunch
instructions: ["Lie on your back with knees bent and legs raised.","Use your abdomen to curl your pelvis slightly toward your chest.","Lower your hips slowly without swinging your legs."]

name: Lying Leg Raise
instructions: ["Lie flat with your legs extended.","Brace your core and raise your legs while keeping them controlled.","Lower them slowly without letting your lower back excessively arch."]

name: Superman
instructions: ["Lie face down with arms extended in front of you.","Gently lift your arms, chest, and legs from the floor.","Pause briefly, then lower under control."]

name: Mountain Climber
instructions: ["Start in a high plank position.","Drive one knee toward your chest while keeping your hips controlled.","Switch legs continuously at a pace you can maintain."]

name: Burpee
instructions: ["From standing, squat down and place your hands on the floor.","Move your feet back to a plank, then return them toward your hands.","Stand or jump upward and repeat under control."]

name: Jumping Jack
instructions: ["Stand with feet together and arms by your sides.","Jump your feet apart while raising your arms overhead.","Jump back to the starting position and repeat rhythmically."]

name: High Knees
instructions: ["Stand tall and begin jogging in place.","Drive each knee upward toward hip height as comfortable.","Keep a steady rhythm and land lightly on your feet."]

name: Jump Squat
instructions: ["Lower into a comfortable squat.","Drive through your feet and jump upward.","Land softly, regain your squat position, and repeat."]

name: Jump Rope
instructions: ["Hold the rope handles with elbows close to your sides.","Turn the rope mainly with your wrists.","Make small controlled jumps as the rope passes beneath your feet."]

name: Wall Sit
instructions: ["Stand with your back against a wall and step your feet forward.","Slide down until you reach a comfortable seated position.","Keep your back against the wall and hold while breathing steadily."]

name: Child's Pose
instructions: ["Kneel on the floor and sit your hips toward your heels.","Reach your arms forward and lower your torso comfortably.","Relax and breathe slowly while holding the stretch."]

name: Cat-Cow Stretch
instructions: ["Begin on hands and knees.","Gently round your back upward, then reverse by opening your chest and tilting your pelvis.","Move slowly between the two positions with your breathing."]

name: Kneeling Hip Flexor Stretch
instructions: ["Kneel with one foot placed in front of you.","Keep your torso tall and gently shift your hips forward.","Hold the stretch at the front of the rear hip, then switch sides."]

name: 90/90 Hamstring Stretch
instructions: ["Lie on your back and raise one thigh with the hip and knee bent.","Slowly straighten that knee until you feel a comfortable hamstring stretch.","Return gently and repeat before switching legs."]

name: Quadriceps Stretch
instructions: ["Stand tall and hold a stable support if needed.","Bend one knee and bring that heel toward your glutes.","Hold the ankle gently, keep your knees close, then switch sides."]

name: Calf Stretch
instructions: ["Place your hands against a wall and step one foot backward.","Keep the rear heel down and the rear knee comfortably straight.","Lean forward until you feel a calf stretch, then switch sides."]

name: Chest Stretch
instructions: ["Place one forearm against a wall or doorway.","Keep your shoulder relaxed and gently rotate your torso away.","Hold a comfortable stretch, then repeat on the other side."]

name: Shoulder Stretch
instructions: ["Bring one arm across the front of your chest.","Use the opposite arm to gently draw it closer.","Keep the shoulder relaxed, hold, then switch sides."]

name: Figure-Four Glute Stretch
instructions: ["Lie on your back and cross one ankle over the opposite thigh.","Draw the supporting leg toward your torso.","Hold the glute stretch comfortably, then switch sides."]

name: Butterfly Stretch
instructions: ["Sit tall and bring the soles of your feet together.","Allow your knees to move outward without forcing them.","Hold your feet and lean forward slightly if comfortable."]

name: Dumbbell Bench Press
instructions: ["Lie on a bench holding dumbbells near chest level.","Press the dumbbells upward until your arms are extended.","Lower them under control to a comfortable depth."]

name: Incline Dumbbell Press
instructions: ["Set a bench to a moderate incline and hold dumbbells near your upper chest.","Press the weights upward without letting your shoulders shrug.","Lower under control and repeat."]

name: Dumbbell Fly
instructions: ["Lie on a bench with dumbbells above your chest and elbows slightly bent.","Open your arms outward in a controlled arc.","Bring the dumbbells back together using your chest."]

name: One-Arm Dumbbell Row
instructions: ["Support one hand and knee on a bench and hold a dumbbell in the other hand.","Pull the dumbbell toward your hip while keeping your torso stable.","Lower the weight under control and repeat before switching sides."]

name: Dumbbell Pullover
instructions: ["Lie on a bench holding one dumbbell above your chest with both hands.","Lower the dumbbell behind your head with a slight elbow bend.","Pull it back over your chest without excessive back arching."]

name: Dumbbell Shoulder Press
instructions: ["Hold dumbbells at shoulder height.","Brace your torso and press the weights overhead.","Lower them slowly back to shoulder level."]

name: Dumbbell Lateral Raise
instructions: ["Hold light dumbbells by your sides with elbows slightly bent.","Raise your arms out to the sides to around shoulder height.","Lower slowly without swinging."]

name: Dumbbell Front Raise
instructions: ["Hold dumbbells in front of your thighs.","Raise one or both arms forward to around shoulder height.","Lower under control without using momentum."]

name: Dumbbell Reverse Fly
instructions: ["Hinge forward with a neutral back and hold dumbbells below you.","Open your arms out to the sides with a soft elbow bend.","Squeeze your upper back briefly, then lower under control."]

name: Dumbbell Biceps Curl
instructions: ["Stand tall with dumbbells by your sides.","Keep your upper arms still and curl the weights toward your shoulders.","Lower slowly until your elbows are extended."]

name: Hammer Curl
instructions: ["Hold dumbbells with palms facing each other.","Curl the weights while keeping your elbows close to your sides.","Lower under control without swinging."]

name: Dumbbell Triceps Extension
instructions: ["Hold one dumbbell overhead with both hands.","Bend your elbows to lower the dumbbell behind your head.","Extend your elbows to return overhead while keeping your upper arms stable."]

name: Dumbbell Lunge
instructions: ["Hold dumbbells by your sides and stand tall.","Step forward and lower into a controlled lunge.","Push through the front foot to return, then alternate sides."]

name: Dumbbell Romanian Deadlift
instructions: ["Hold dumbbells in front of your thighs.","Push your hips backward while keeping the weights close to your legs.","Stop when you feel a hamstring stretch, then drive your hips forward to stand."]

name: Bulgarian Split Squat
instructions: ["Stand in front of a bench and place the top of one foot behind you on it.","Lower your body by bending the front knee while keeping your balance.","Push through the front foot to stand and repeat before switching sides."]

name: Dumbbell Shrug
instructions: ["Stand with dumbbells at your sides.","Raise your shoulders straight upward without rolling them.","Pause briefly, then lower them under control."]

name: Farmer's Walk
instructions: ["Hold a dumbbell in each hand and stand tall.","Brace your core and walk with controlled steps.","Keep your shoulders stable and maintain an upright posture."]

name: Dumbbell Side Bend
instructions: ["Stand tall holding one dumbbell at your side.","Slowly bend your torso toward the weighted side.","Use your side abdominal muscles to return upright, then switch sides."]

name: Dumbbell Wrist Curl
instructions: ["Sit and support your forearms on your thighs with palms facing upward.","Allow the dumbbells to lower toward your fingers.","Curl your wrists upward, then lower slowly."]

name: Dumbbell Step-Up
instructions: ["Hold dumbbells at your sides and place one foot fully on a stable step.","Drive through that foot to step onto the platform.","Step down under control and repeat before switching sides."]

name: Barbell Bench Press
instructions: ["Lie on a bench with your feet planted and grip the bar slightly wider than shoulder width.","Lower the bar under control toward your mid-chest.","Press the bar upward until your arms are extended."]

name: Barbell Overhead Press
instructions: ["Hold the bar around shoulder height with a comfortable grip.","Brace your torso and press the bar overhead.","Lower it under control back toward your shoulders."]

name: Barbell Bent-Over Row
instructions: ["Hold the bar and hinge at your hips with a neutral back.","Pull the bar toward your lower ribs while keeping your torso stable.","Lower the bar until your arms are extended."]

name: Barbell Back Squat
instructions: ["Position the bar securely across your upper back and stand with a stable stance.","Sit your hips down and back while bending your knees.","Drive through your feet to return to standing."]

name: Conventional Deadlift
instructions: ["Stand with the bar over mid-foot and grip it outside your legs.","Brace your trunk and push the floor away as you extend your hips and knees.","Stand tall, then return the bar to the floor under control."]

name: Romanian Deadlift
instructions: ["Hold the bar in front of your thighs with knees slightly bent.","Push your hips backward while keeping the bar close to your legs.","Drive your hips forward to stand when you reach a comfortable hamstring stretch."]

name: Barbell Hip Thrust
instructions: ["Sit with your upper back supported on a bench and the bar padded across your hips.","Drive through your feet and extend your hips upward.","Squeeze your glutes at the top, then lower under control."]

name: Barbell Lunge
instructions: ["Position the bar securely across your upper back.","Step forward and lower into a controlled lunge.","Push through the front foot to return and repeat on the other side."]

name: Barbell Biceps Curl
instructions: ["Stand tall holding the bar with palms facing forward.","Keep your upper arms near your torso and curl the bar upward.","Lower the bar slowly until your elbows are extended."]

name: Barbell Calf Raise
instructions: ["Position the bar securely and stand with a stable stance.","Rise onto the balls of your feet as high as comfortable.","Pause briefly, then lower your heels under control."]

name: Lat Pulldown
instructions: ["Sit securely at the pulldown station and hold the bar wider than shoulder width.","Pull the bar toward your upper chest by driving your elbows down.","Return the bar upward under control."]

name: Seated Cable Row
instructions: ["Sit tall with feet supported and hold the cable handle.","Pull the handle toward your torso while drawing your shoulders back.","Extend your arms again without rounding excessively."]

name: Cable Wood Chop
instructions: ["Stand sideways to the cable with both hands on the handle.","Rotate through your torso and hips while drawing the handle diagonally across your body.","Return slowly and repeat before switching sides."]

name: Triceps Pushdown
instructions: ["Stand facing a high cable and hold the attachment with elbows near your sides.","Extend your elbows to push the attachment downward.","Return slowly without letting your upper arms drift forward."]

name: Cable Biceps Curl
instructions: ["Stand facing a low cable and hold the attachment with palms forward.","Keep your upper arms stable and curl the attachment upward.","Lower under control until your elbows are extended."]

name: Face Pull
instructions: ["Set a rope attachment around face height.","Pull the rope toward your face while separating your hands.","Squeeze your upper back briefly, then return under control."]

name: Straight-Arm Pulldown
instructions: ["Stand facing a high cable with arms mostly straight.","Pull the attachment down toward your thighs without turning it into a row.","Return slowly while keeping tension through your lats."]

name: Cable Lateral Raise
instructions: ["Stand beside a low cable and hold the handle with the outside hand.","Raise your arm out to the side to around shoulder height.","Lower slowly and repeat before switching sides."]

name: Cable Crunch
instructions: ["Kneel facing a high cable with the attachment near your head.","Brace your hips and curl your torso downward using your abdomen.","Return slowly without pulling mainly with your arms."]

name: Leg Press
instructions: ["Sit securely in the machine with feet placed comfortably on the platform.","Lower the platform by bending your knees to a comfortable depth.","Press through your feet to extend your legs without locking forcefully."]

name: Leg Extension
instructions: ["Adjust the machine so the pad sits comfortably above your ankles.","Extend your knees to raise the pad.","Pause briefly, then lower under control."]

name: Lying Leg Curl
instructions: ["Lie on the machine with the pad positioned above your heels.","Curl your lower legs toward your glutes.","Lower the weight slowly until your knees are nearly extended."]

name: Machine Chest Press
instructions: ["Adjust the seat so the handles are around chest height.","Press the handles forward while keeping your back against the pad.","Return slowly to a comfortable starting position."]

name: Machine Shoulder Press
instructions: ["Adjust the seat so the handles begin around shoulder level.","Press the handles overhead without shrugging excessively.","Lower them under control."]

name: Assisted Pull-Up
instructions: ["Set enough assistance to perform controlled repetitions.","Grip the handles and pull yourself upward by driving your elbows down.","Lower under control until your arms are extended."]

name: Ab Crunch Machine
instructions: ["Adjust the seat and pads to fit your body comfortably.","Brace your abdomen and curl your torso forward against the resistance.","Return slowly without letting the weight pull you backward."]

name: Hip Abduction Machine
instructions: ["Sit securely with the pads against the outside of your thighs.","Press your knees outward against the resistance.","Return slowly without allowing the weight to snap back."]

name: Hip Adduction Machine
instructions: ["Sit securely with the pads against the inside of your thighs.","Bring your knees inward against the resistance.","Return outward slowly to a comfortable range."]

name: Cable Glute Kickback
instructions: ["Attach an ankle strap to a low cable and hold a support.","Extend one leg backward without excessively arching your lower back.","Squeeze your glute, return slowly, and switch sides."]

name: Seated Calf Raise
instructions: ["Sit with the machine pad secured above your knees.","Raise your heels by pressing through the balls of your feet.","Pause briefly, then lower your heels slowly."]

name: Back Extension
instructions: ["Set yourself securely on a back-extension bench or machine.","Lower your torso by hinging at the hips while keeping your spine controlled.","Use your posterior chain to return to a neutral body line."]

name: Kettlebell Swing
instructions: ["Stand with the kettlebell slightly in front of you and hinge at your hips.","Swing it back between your legs while keeping your spine controlled.","Drive your hips forward to propel the kettlebell to around chest height."]

name: Goblet Squat
instructions: ["Hold the kettlebell close to your chest.","Sit your hips down and back while keeping your chest tall.","Push through your feet to return to standing."]

name: Kettlebell Deadlift
instructions: ["Stand over the kettlebell with a stable stance.","Hinge at your hips, bend your knees, and grip the handle.","Stand by extending your hips and knees, then return the kettlebell under control."]

name: Kettlebell Overhead Press
instructions: ["Hold a kettlebell securely at shoulder level.","Brace your torso and press it overhead.","Lower it under control and repeat before switching sides if using one arm."]

name: Band Pull-Apart
instructions: ["Hold a resistance band in front of you at shoulder height.","Pull your hands apart while keeping your arms mostly straight.","Squeeze your upper back, then return slowly."]

name: Resistance Band Row
instructions: ["Anchor the band securely in front of you and hold both ends.","Pull your hands toward your torso while drawing your shoulders back.","Return slowly until your arms are extended."]

name: Resistance Band Chest Press
instructions: ["Anchor the band securely behind you at chest height.","Hold the handles near your chest and press forward.","Return slowly while keeping your torso stable."]

name: Resistance Band Biceps Curl
instructions: ["Stand on the middle of the band and hold the ends with palms forward.","Keep your elbows close and curl your hands upward.","Lower slowly while maintaining band tension."]

name: Treadmill Running
instructions: ["Step onto the treadmill and begin at a comfortable walking pace.","Increase speed gradually to your planned running pace.","Maintain an upright posture and finish by reducing speed gradually."]

name: Stationary Bike
instructions: ["Adjust the seat so your knee remains slightly bent at the bottom of the pedal stroke.","Begin pedaling at a comfortable resistance.","Maintain a steady cadence and adjust resistance to match your workout."]

name: Elliptical Trainer
instructions: ["Step onto the pedals and hold the handles securely.","Begin moving smoothly at a comfortable resistance.","Keep an upright posture and maintain a steady rhythm."]

name: Stationary Rowing
instructions: ["Start with knees bent, torso controlled, and arms extended.","Drive through your legs first, then lean slightly back and pull the handle toward your lower ribs.","Reverse the sequence smoothly to return to the start."]

name: Stair Climber
instructions: ["Step onto the machine and begin at a low speed.","Stay upright and take controlled steps without leaning heavily on the handles.","Adjust the pace to your fitness level and slow down before stopping."]
